display.title: Episode 501: The Return of Little Tzip Tzip
display.summary_short: Tzivos Hashem's worldwide mission, Shema with a first-grade yeshiva class, and the little bird Tzip Tzip, who smells something bad everywhere she flies until her mother wipes her nose.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi describes Tzivos Hashem as a worldwide army, from Leningrad and Madrid to Yerushalayim, whose Commander-in-Chief is Hashem. The order of the day: like Avraham Avinu, every soldier should help others know Hashem, for example by signing up a friend and earning points toward a higher rank. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from Oholei Torah recites the Shema, and Uncle Yossi tells listeners about their rebbe's Chumash commentary for children and his parsha tapes. After tzedakah, he teaches that Hashem's blessings come when there is achdus, as we say in Sim Shalom, 'bless us, our Father, all of us as one'. Story time: the baby bird Tzip Tzip learns to fly and sets out east, west, north and south, but each time hurries home complaining of a terrible smell, until her mother finds a speck of dirt on the tip of her nose. Uncle Yossi explains: look at others with a good eye; the Baal Shem Tov taught that a fault we see in another is like a mirror, and the Sages say to correct ourselves first. A listener's letter asks where to put up a new mezuzah, and Uncle Yossi explains the right side, the height and the brachah.
display.lesson: Look at others with a good eye; a fault we see in someone else may be our own, so correct yourself first.
